title: Latent clip previews collapse to still mode when the one-shot preview marker is missed
description: MiniMax H3 latents burst a whole clip per sampler step and played back at arrival speed (once per step, super fast) instead of looping at the clip rate. Clip mode is a one-shot latch on the gallery card element, armed by a single VHS_latentpreview event; a miss is unrecoverable for the run. Make clip state durable on the generation entry, re-read per frame, and honour the marker rate/length the app currently discards.
